why: Image 2 has one believable night light, a warm pool raking across the counter from the lamp column with a soft fall-off, and its turntable, record and dust cover read cleanly as real objects. Image 1 has more incidental life (the coupe, the stone counter, shallow focus), but up close it falls apart: the turntable is a murky stack of planes with a stray vertical line through it, the stone is smeared, blotchy noise sits over everything, and the flat grey light gives the room no source.
